content.text: In Nigeria, Stripe and PayPal block 90% of creators. In Venezuela, currency controls make Gumroad impossible. Your digital products deserve better [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-15|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-selling-ebooks-without-paypal-stripe-5|architecture]]. This guide deploys a crypto store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-what-actually-13|Cloudflare Webhook-Driven]] Pages—sovereign infrastructure immune to platform rejection. No subscriptions. No middlemen. Own the stack. Accept 300+ cryptocurrencies. Deliver products instantly. Built for creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable, this solution leverages Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. You’ll own the entire stack after deployment. No platform dependencies. No recurring fees. Lifetime access.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront for free—static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers. Supabase stores orders and customer data in a PostgreSQL database. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain, firing webhooks to deliver products instantly. This stack bypasses payment platforms entirely. No Stripe API keys. No PayPal accounts. No currency restrictions. Your store runs on infrastructure you own. Cloudflare’s global edge network ensures low latency for customers worldwide. Supabase’s serverless database scales automatically with demand. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON. This architecture is designed for creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. By owning the stack, you eliminate platform dependencies and recurring fees, ensuring lifetime access to your infrastructure.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Register a domain name or use a Cloudflare Pages subdomain for free. Create a Cloudflare account to access Pages and Workers. Set up a Supabase project for order storage. Sign up for NOWPayments to generate API keys for crypto payment verification. Prepare your digital products—ebooks, courses, templates—as downloadable files. Cloudflare Pages requires a GitHub repository to deploy your storefront. Cloudflare Workers use JavaScript or WebAssembly for backend logic. Supabase provides a PostgreSQL database and authentication services. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee per transaction. Ensure your digital products are hosted on a reliable storage solution like Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Familiarize yourself with basic JavaScript and HTML to customize your storefront and backend logic. No prior experience with crypto payments is required—NOWPayments handles on-chain verification automatically.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Deploy your storefront to Cloudflare Pages. Write a Cloudflare Worker to handle order processing and webhook logic. Configure NOWPayments to verify crypto payments and trigger webhooks. Store order data in Supabase. Deliver products via signed URLs from Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Test the pipeline with testnet transactions before going live. Cloudflare Workers execute backend logic at the edge, ensuring fast response times. Supabase’s real-time database updates allow you to track orders in real time. NOWPayments’ webhooks automatically deliver products once payment is confirmed on-chain. Use signed URLs to securely deliver digital products without exposing direct download links. Testnet transactions allow you to verify the entire pipeline without risking real funds. Ensure your webhook logic handles errors and retries to prevent failed deliveries.
Cloudflare Pages and Workers give you global edge delivery—no servers required.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Connect your domain to Cloudflare Pages. Configure DNS records for email deliverability if selling digital products via email. Test the entire stack on mainnet with a small transaction. Promote your store to your audience. Monitor Supabase for new orders and Cloudflare Workers logs for errors. Cloudflare’s DNS management ensures your domain resolves correctly to your storefront. Email deliverability is critical for digital products sent via email—configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records. Mainnet testing verifies that your payment and delivery pipeline works with real cryptocurrency. Promote your store through social media, email newsletters, or your existing audience. Monitor Supabase for new orders and use Cloudflare Workers logs to debug any issues. Once live, your store is fully operational and ready to accept crypto payments from customers worldwide.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Add more products by uploading files to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Update your storefront HTML and redeploy to Cloudflare Pages. Optimize Cloudflare Workers for higher traffic. Use Supabase’s scaling features to handle more orders. Monitor NOWPayments transaction volume and adjust fee structures if necessary. Cloudflare R2 provides scalable and affordable storage for your digital products. Redeploying your storefront to Cloudflare Pages is as simple as pushing changes to your GitHub repository. Cloudflare Workers automatically scale to handle increased traffic without additional configuration. Supabase’s serverless database scales with demand, ensuring your store can handle growing order volumes. Monitor NOWPayments transaction volume to ensure you’re using the most cost-effective cryptocurrency networks. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing by COREMERCH.

Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with end-to-end testing. Stack 01 is ideal for creators who want to deploy quickly and handle basic product delivery. Stack 02 offers advanced features like scalable backend logic, real-time order tracking, and email deliverability configuration. Both stacks integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Choose Stack 01 if you’re comfortable with DIY deployment and have fewer products. Choose Stack 02 if you need a fully tested, scalable solution deployed by experts.
NOWPayments verifies 300+ cryptocurrencies on-chain with a 0.5% fee—no KYC needed.

Your Deployment Checklist

Register a domain or use a Cloudflare Pages subdomain. Create a Cloudflare account. Set up a Supabase project. Sign up for NOWPayments. Prepare your digital products. Deploy your storefront to Cloudflare Pages. Write a Cloudflare Worker for order processing. Configure NOWPayments webhooks. Store order data in Supabase. Deliver products via signed URLs. Test the pipeline on testnet. Connect your domain to Cloudflare Pages. Configure DNS records for email deliverability. Test on mainnet with a small transaction. Promote your store to your audience. Monitor Supabase and Cloudflare Workers logs. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for advanced features and expert deployment.

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes. Both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages support static hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Pages offers faster edge delivery and custom domains. GitHub Pages is simpler for basic deployments. Choose Cloudflare Pages for better performance and scalability. Both platforms are free to use and integrate seamlessly with backend services like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, deployed in 4-6 hours. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with end-to-end testing. What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, Solana, and TRON. Recommended low-fee networks include BSC, Solana, and TRON—under $0.10 per transaction. No buyer account is required, and payments are verified automatically on-chain. NOWPayments’ webhooks trigger product delivery the moment payment confirms.
